introduction_markdown:
Cameroon General Certificate of Education Board, General Certificate of Education Examination, ORDINARY LEVEL, June 2019. Additional Mathematics, Paper 2, subject code 0575. Time allowed: two and a half hours.

Answer ALL QUESTIONS IN SECTION A and ANY TWO QUESTIONS FROM EITHER SECTION B or SECTION C. In Sections B and C, ALL QUESTIONS CARRY EQUAL MARKS. Candidates are expected to answer a combination of Section A and Section B OR Section A and Section C, but NOT a combination of all three.

Section A: Pure Mathematics (compulsory to all candidates, answer all questions). Section B: Mechanics (answer any two questions; if this section is chosen, then Section C may not be chosen). Section C: Statistics and Probability (if this section is chosen, then Section B may not be chosen; answer any two questions).

All necessary working must be shown. No marks will be awarded for answers without brief statements showing how the answers have been obtained. Electronic calculators may be used. Where necessary take $g$ as $10\ \mathrm{m\,s^{-2}}$.

Chaque question de B et C vaut 17 points imprimes (egalite annoncee par le sujet).

Q10(iii) : DONNEES INCOHERENTES. Avec des masses m, n et 3 kg aux points 7j, 3i et (5i + 4j) et un centre de gravite (3i + 6j), la composante en i donne m = 2 et celle en j donne n = -2/3, valeur negative impossible pour une masse. Le corrige donne ce resultat des donnees imprimees et le signale ; je n'ai pas modifie le sujet. Lecture des vecteurs relue sur le scan (7j, 3i, 5i + 4j, 3i + 6j nets).

questions.enonce_markdown:
(i) The rate of change of the radius of a sphere is $3\ \mathrm{cm\,s^{-1}}$ at the instant when the radius is $5\ \mathrm{cm}$. Find the rate of change of the surface area of the sphere.

[surface area of a sphere $=4\pi r^2$] *[5 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
Let $A=4\pi r^2$. By the chain rule, with time $t$:

$$
\frac{dA}{dt}=\frac{dA}{dr}\times\frac{dr}{dt}=8\pi r\times\frac{dr}{dt}
$$

With $r=5$ and $\dfrac{dr}{dt}=3$:

$$
\frac{dA}{dt}=8\pi(5)(3)=120\pi\approx377
$$

**The surface area increases at $120\pi\approx377\ \mathrm{cm^2\,s^{-1}}$.**

questions.enonce_markdown: (ii) The area bounded by the curve $y^2=3x+2$, the $x$-axis and the ordinates $x=0$ and $x=1$ is rotated completely about the $x$-axis. Find, in terms of $\pi$, the volume of the solid generated. *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The volume of revolution about the $x$-axis is $V=\pi\displaystyle\int_a^b y^2\,dx$.

$$
V=\pi\int_0^1(3x+2)\,dx=\pi\left[\frac{3x^2}{2}+2x\right]_0^1=\pi\left(\frac32+2\right)-0=\frac{7\pi}{2}
$$

**The volume is $\dfrac{7\pi}{2}$ cubic units** ($\approx11.0$).
themes: solids of revolution about the x-axis

questions.enonce_markdown: (iii) The position vector of the centre of gravity of particles of mass $m\ \mathrm{kg}$, $n\ \mathrm{kg}$ and $3\ \mathrm{kg}$ which are at the points with position vectors $7\mathbf{j}$, $3\mathbf{i}$ and $(5\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j})$ respectively is $(3\mathbf{i}+6\mathbf{j})$. Given that $m$ and $n$ are constants, find the values of $m$ and $n$. *[6 marks]*
questions.corrige_markdown:
The position vector of the centre of gravity is $\bar{\mathbf r}=\dfrac{\sum m_i\mathbf r_i}{\sum m_i}$, so

$$
(m+n+3)(3\mathbf{i}+6\mathbf{j})=m(7\mathbf{j})+n(3\mathbf{i})+3(5\mathbf{i}+4\mathbf{j})=(3n+15)\mathbf{i}+(7m+12)\mathbf{j}
$$

Equate the coefficients:

$$
\mathbf{i}:\ 3(m+n+3)=3n+15\ \Rightarrow\ 3m+9=15\ \Rightarrow\ m=2
$$

$$
\mathbf{j}:\ 6(m+n+3)=7m+12\ \Rightarrow\ 6n+18=m+12\ \Rightarrow\ 6n=m-6=-4\ \Rightarrow\ n=-\frac23
$$

**$m=2$ and $n=-\dfrac23$** with the data as printed.

*Remark:* a mass cannot be negative, so the printed data are inconsistent (the examiner probably intended different numbers). The method is what is tested: equate the $\mathbf{i}$ and $\mathbf{j}$ components of $\sum m_i\mathbf r_i=(\sum m_i)\,\bar{\mathbf r}$.
